label: Rugutis system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a Rugutis locus that can restrict bacteriophage infection.
observations: Rugutis branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual Rugutis genes, Rugutis proteins, DefenseFinder article-registry rows, source-database rows naming one Rugutis locus, unresolved Rugutis triggers or effector activities, and other phage defense systems.
